stories.title: OpenAI's Data agent turns ChatGPT Work into an analytics layer
stories.summary: The new agent connects to company data, investigates business questions and can build interactive dashboards from a conversation.
stories.why_it_matters: It pushes workplace AI beyond answering questions toward analyzing live business data and producing decision-ready outputs.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Financial Services brings premium data into AI workflows
stories.summary: OpenAI is packaging financial data, citations and GPT-6 Astra reasoning into a specialized version of ChatGPT Work.
stories.why_it_matters: AI vendors are moving from generic assistants into industry-specific systems tied directly to proprietary data and workflows.

stories.title: Anthropic's new threat report shows how AI misuse is spreading across the cyber kill chain
stories.summary: Anthropic says it disrupted malicious uses of Claude involving cyber operations, surveillance, influence activity, fraud and illicit model distillation.
stories.why_it_matters: The immediate security impact of capable AI may be faster, broader adversary operations across the whole attack chain—not just novel exploits.

stories.title: OpenAI backs mandatory national AI safety rules
stories.summary: The company says Congress should adopt capability-based requirements while it continues supporting state legislation in the absence of federal action.
stories.why_it_matters: The policy fight is shifting from whether AI should be regulated toward who sets the rules and how capability thresholds are defined.

stories.title: GPT-6 Astra raises the stakes for AI agents and cybersecurity
stories.summary: OpenAI's newest flagship model is designed for complex end-to-end work, with major gains in computer use, coding, research and cyber capability.
stories.why_it_matters: The frontier-model race is increasingly about systems that can act across software and complete long professional workflows, raising both productivity and safety stakes.
